title: Chameleon: Foundation Models for Fairness-aware Multi-modal Data Augmentation to Enhance Coverage of Minorities

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the representation and coverage of different racial/ethnic groups in image datasets (FERETDB, UTKFace) and evaluating the performance disparity (Precision, Recall, F1-score) of a downstream Convolutional Neural Network across these demographic groups before and after synthetic data augmentation.

Identifying under-represented combinations of gender alongside other demographic attributes (such as race and age) in image datasets to measure data coverage deficits and resolve them via targeted generative AI data augmentation.

Assessing the representation of various age groups in intersectional combinations (with race and gender) within the UTKFace dataset to identify missing coverage patterns and guide synthetic image generation.
